subject: CORRECTION: isolated Liger Qwen3.5 whole-model nonmutating A/B
body: The immediately prior 011649Z proposal file was malformed/empty due a PowerShell metadata typo; ignore that zero-byte artifact. Correct proposal: Liger Kernel 0.8.4 has explicit Qwen3.5 dense support. Lane A downloaded/extracted the wheel only under D:\VERA\.scratch\liger-qwen35-sandbox-20261004; nothing installed into either training environment. Exact patch: RMSNorm, SwiGLU, fused linear cross entropy; Qwen3.5 RoPE remains disabled. Proposed gate: separate sandbox branch/worktree from hardened accelerated head b97caa375debe404286f10dc834b585a380af916; baseline backend=fla_triton; exact base/rows4096-4103/seed/batching; control without Liger versus candidate with Liger; NO optimizer and NO weight mutation. Candidate must preserve completion-only labels/loss semantics, trainable LoRA coverage and finite gradient evidence while delivering material whole-model backward and/or peak-memory improvement. No global install, no recipe promotion from microbenchmarks. Please attack fused-linear-CE compatibility with completion-only masking, PEFT target coverage after monkey-patching, and the minimum benefit worth an added dependency.
